segments.text: Mercantile Law is a commercial-law paper built around ten statutes/areas in the FPSC syllabus. It is highly manageable when studied through definitions, essentials, distinctions, rights/duties and remedies.

items.text: For every statute, memorize definitions last; understand the transaction first.
Practice distinctions because FPSC frequently asks them.
Use current bare acts for section numbers and amendments.
Where the old FPSC text names a repealed statute, preserve the syllabus concept but read the current law.

segments.text: Think transaction-by-transaction. Contract law supplies general principles; sale, partnership, negotiable instruments and company law apply them in specialized commercial settings. Competition, electronic transactions, electronic funds, consumer protection and arbitration regulate modern market behaviour and remedies.
